facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} {A : Type*} {B : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid A] [AddCommMonoid B] [Module R A] [Module R B] [CoalgebraStruct R A] [CoalgebraStruct R B] (f : A →ₗc[R] B) (g : B →ₗc[R] A) (h₁ : f.comp g = CoalgHom.id R B) (h₂ : g.comp f = CoalgHom.id R A) (a : A), ¬ ((VTask.ofCoalgHom f g h₁ h₂) a ≠ f a)
